paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Netanel, a pupil of Rabban Yohanan ben Zakkai, and he feared sin: Avot 2:8, 9, and chapter 5. In Tosefta Avodah Zarah, chapter 3: Rabban Gamliel the Elder married his daughter to Shimon ben Netanel and stipulated with him that she should not prepare ritually pure things with him. He saw the Temple and its destruction. He was one of Rabban Yohanan ben Zakkai's pupils who were given tidings of life in the world to come. Together with R' Yosef the priest—see his entry—he expounded the Work of the Chariot. Hesed le-Avraham, spring 5, river 25, writes: Moshe struck Og king of Bashan because in Og there was a holy spark, the spark of Shimon ben Netanel, whose initials spell Bashan. He was delivered into Moshe's hand because R' Shimon ben Netanel was Rabban Yohanan ben Zakkai's pupil, and the latter has a root from Moshe; see his entry. Because he feared sin, it says, “Do not fear him.” End of quotation. His burial is in Kefar Alma; see R' Elazar ben Arakh.
